summary: dict2items converts a dictionary into a list of dictionaries with key and value entries.
questions: How do I loop over a dictionary in Ansible?
How do I turn a dict into a list of key/value pairs?

answer_card.title: dict2items filter
answer_card.answer_md: `dict2items` transforms a dictionary into a list of `{key: ..., value: ...}` items, which is handy for looping over a dict with `loop`.
